LESSON: MAKING CHOICES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.3: Making choices

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Making choices
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What are the effects of the choices you make?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss results of choices they make in daily life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: discuss results of choices they make in daily life

Teach
• Today’s focus: discuss results of choices they make in daily life.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “discuss results of choices they make in daily life” using a school example.
• Model B for “discuss results of choices they make in daily life” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "discuss results of choices they make in daily life" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: discuss results of choices they make in daily life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss results of choices they make in daily life

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Making choices.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the effects of the choices you make?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• discuss results of choices they make in daily life
